# Test fixtures

Real config files used as golden inputs. Layout: `<emulator>/<version>/<path
relative to the emulator's config root>`.

## `*/emudeck-default/` and `emudeck-launchers/`

These are copied verbatim from EmuDeck:

- **Repo:** https://github.com/dragoonDorise/EmuDeck (canonical backend repo)
- **Branch / commit:** `main` @ `dddb30229adbbd54d5ff7283cfd70e11c4322c26` (2026-10-05)
- **License:** GNU General Public License v3.0 (`LICENSE` in that repo).
  These files are © the EmuDeck contributors. They're redistributed here
  unmodified, under GPL-3.0, as test data only. The full license text is at
  https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-3.0.txt.

| Fixture | Source path in EmuDeck |
|---------|------------------------|
| `dolphin/emudeck-default/{GCPadNew,WiimoteNew,Hotkeys,GCKeyNew,DSUClient,Dolphin}.ini` | `configs/org.DolphinEmu.dolphin-emu/config/dolphin-emu/` |
| `dolphin/emudeck-default/Profiles/{GCPad,Wiimote}/*.ini` | `configs/org.DolphinEmu.dolphin-emu/config/dolphin-emu/Profiles/` |
| `pcsx2/emudeck-default/inis/PCSX2.ini` | `configs/pcsx2qt/.config/PCSX2/inis/PCSX2.ini` (fallback template only, see below) |
| `pcsx2/emudeck-default/PCSX2QT_setupControllers.ini` | **Extracted**, not a file upstream: the `[Hotkeys]`, `[Pad1]`, `[Pad2]` bodies from `PCSX2QT_setupControllers()` in `functions/EmuScripts/emuDeckPCSX2QT.sh`. The bodies are verbatim; the three leading `;` comment lines and the section headers were added. |
| `duckstation/emudeck-default/settings.ini` | `configs/duckstation/settings.ini` |
| `retroarch/emudeck-default/retroarch.cfg` | `configs/org.libretro.RetroArch/config/retroarch/retroarch.cfg` |
| `retroarch/emudeck-default/config/remaps/<core>/<core>.rmp.disabled` | `configs/org.libretro.RetroArch/config/retroarch/config/remaps/` |
| `emudeck-launchers/{dolphin-emu,pcsx2-qt,duckstation,retroarch}.sh` | `tools/launchers/` |

Notes:

- The templates still contain EmuDeck's placeholder paths
  (`/run/media/mmcblk0p1/Emulation/...`, `/home/deck`). EmuDeck rewrites them
  on install.
- These are the **repo templates**, not a captured device state. On a device,
  Dolphin's `GCPadNew.ini` is also changed by the controller-layout swap and by
  AutoMap at every launch. PCSX2's `PCSX2.ini` is normally generated by
  `pcsx2-Qt -testconfig`, with `PCSX2QT_setupControllers` written over it.
  See [data/defaults/README.md](../../data/defaults/README.md).
- The launcher scripts are test data. Never run them: they `git pull` and
  source the EmuDeck backend.

## Device captures: `devices/<scenario>/` and `<emulator>/<scenario>/`

Captured from the owner's Steam Deck with `tools/deck.sh capture <scenario>`.
These are the configs as they are on the
device, scrubbed on the Deck by `tools/deck-scrub.py` before anything leaves
it. MACs (also inside Steam's slot handles, including slots kept for pads that
have disconnected) and USB serials (in `uniq`, and in `usb-devices.tsv`) become lookalikes: a MAC keeps
its real vendor half, a serial keeps its length and case, and the rest is an
HMAC under a salt that exists only on the Deck
(`~/.local/state/map-helper/capture-salt`), so fakes can't be reversed but one
pad keeps one fake in every capture. Credential values (`*password*`,
`*token*`, `*username*`, `*nickname*`, `*api_key*`; the quotes go too, so
`cheevos_password = ""` becomes `cheevos_password = `) and Dolphin's
`[Analytics] ID` are blanked, and Dolphin's `TimePlayed`, `Qt`, `Logger`,
`GFX`, `FreeLook` and `RetroAchievements` inis are dropped. The scrub refuses to
send anything if an original value survives. Captures taken before the salt
existed were converted with `deck-scrub.py --rekey` on the Deck. Versions are in each
`devices/<scenario>/versions.txt`.

`devices/<scenario>/usb-devices.tsv` lists every USB device except root hubs:
bus id, product string, sysfs `serial`, sysfs path (as `S: Sysfs=` gives it)
and VID:PID, for `usb-serial:` ids (docs/04 §1.2). The capture script records
it from the next capture on; none of the scenarios below has it yet, so
`UsbSerialTest` in `tests/test_devices.py` builds sysfs trees with made-up
serials. Re-capture `8bitdo-u2-usb` and the wired 8BitDo docked to cover it.

| Scenario | Setup |
|----------|-------|
| `dualsense-bt` | 2026-10-22. Steam Deck OLED (board `Galileo`), SteamOS 3.8.28, no game running. One DualSense (`054c:0ce6`) paired over Bluetooth through Steam's settings, Steam Input on (default). A Logitech BT keyboard and mouse were also paired. EmuDeck backend `dddb3022`, `controllerLayout="baxy"`. Dolphin's `GCPadNew.ini` is byte-identical to its own `.bak` from 2025-05-20: pad 1 matches EmuDeck's `GC_base` profile and pads 2–4 `GC_reverse_camera`, not the current template. |
| `dualsense-usb` | Same session, a few minutes later. The DualSense switched off, then plugged into the Deck's USB-C port by cable and woken with PS. Devices only: the emulator configs were identical to `dualsense-bt`'s. |
| `switchpro-usb` | Same session. DualSense off. Switch Pro Controller (`057e:2009`, battery flat) plugged straight into the Deck's USB-C port and woken with Home. Devices only: emulator configs unchanged. |
| `8bitdo-u2-bt` | Same session. Switch Pro unplugged. 8BitDo Ultimate 2 Wireless (`2dc8:6012`), mode switch on Bluetooth, paired through Steam's settings, no dongle. Steam lists it as `type=unknown`. Devices only: emulator configs unchanged. |
| `8bitdo-u2-usb` | Same session. The 8BitDo turned off (Home held), then plugged into the Deck's USB-C port by cable: `2dc8:310b`, with keyboard and mouse nodes too. Steam still lists the Bluetooth session as slot 1 with no virtual pad; the wired pad is slot 2. Devices only: emulator configs unchanged. |
| `all-three` | Same session. 8BitDo unplugged. Turned on in this order: DualSense (BT), 8BitDo Ultimate 2 (BT), Switch Pro (USB cable, still charging). Steam slots 1, 2, 3 in that order; the stale slots from earlier scenarios were gone. Devices only: emulator configs unchanged. |
| `all-three-reordered` | Same session, right after `all-three`. The owner reordered controllers in Steam to Switch Pro, 8BitDo, DualSense, Deck. Devices only: emulator configs unchanged. |
| `devices/game-steam-input-on`, `devices/game-steam-input-off` | Same session. Only the DualSense on (BT). `env.txt` is the SDL and Steam variables (nothing else) of the running Dolphin, launched by ES-DE from a Steam shortcut: first with Steam Input at its default, then with "Disable Steam Input" set for that shortcut. With it disabled no controller worked in the game. |
| `deck-only` | Same day, after the owner restarted the Deck: no external pads (Logitech BT keyboard and mouse still paired), the Deck back in slot 0. Devices only. Its RetroArch capture differed from `dualsense-bt`'s only by the scrub (the first scrub blanked `netplay_show_passworded` and missed the stream keys), so it replaced that file in `retroarch/dualsense-bt/`. |
| `docked` | Same day. The Deck in the owner's dock with the TV on and the dock on wall power; the Switch Pro plugged into a dock USB port to charge. No other pads. Devices only: emulator configs unchanged. |
